name: Sprout Grocery
summary: A responsive grocery storefront demo with a basket, account flows, sample checkout and inventory tools. Catalog and orders are synthetic; it has no real payments or delivery.

name: Paperlocal PDF
summary: Merge PDFs, extract and reorder pages, rotate them, or turn JPG/PNG photos into a PDF locally in the browser.

name: BlueTrace Security Workbench
summary: A local defensive log-triage CLI and localhost interface with a searchable timeline, explainable findings and an incident note. Educational use only.

name: Fieldnotes Service Desk
summary: A local issue-triage board with persistent tickets, priority queues, validated status changes, search and status history. Not for public deployment.

name: Webhook Reliability Lab
summary: Explore delivery retries, bounded exponential backoff, duplicate-event idempotency and local HMAC signatures in a deterministic browser simulator; it sends no real webhooks or API requests.

name: CSV Quality Lab
summary: Profile CSV files, flag malformed rows and common data-quality issues, then export a conservative cleaned copy with an audit report. The new browser edition runs locally in your tab; it does not upload files.

name: Retail SQL Warehouse
summary: Load validated sample sales into a rerunnable SQLite star schema and query revenue, repeat customers and monthly trends.

name: Excel Invoice Studio
summary: Turn a validated JSON quotation into an editable invoice workbook with line formulas, tax totals, payment summary and print-ready layout.

name: Retail Pulse — Excel Sales Dashboard
summary: A synthetic 720-order workbook with a region selector, monthly sales/profit chart, category comparison and transparent row-level formulas.

name: Retail Pulse — Power BI Kit
summary: Synthetic retail data, Power Query, DAX measures, theme and report-building guide. This is an implementation kit, not a finished PBIX/PBIP report. A live HTML reference preview is available; it is not a native Power BI report.

name: Stockroom Ledger
summary: A transactional local stock ledger for receiving, issuing and transferring items, with shortage protection, audit history and CSV export. The browser edition stores a separate demo ledger locally, not in a shared warehouse.

name: Docs Link Auditor
summary: Check a local Markdown tree for missing files, broken relative links and missing heading anchors. External links are skipped, never fetched. The browser edition checks selected folders locally; it does not fetch external links.

name: Java Library Desk
summary: A local lending desk for registering books, checkout, returns, availability and loan history, with an atomic file-backed ledger. Its browser edition stores a separate demo ledger on this device only.

name: Java Route Planner
summary: Find shortest travel-time paths through a synthetic campus graph and optionally avoid closed locations. It is not GPS or live navigation. The browser edition is a synthetic campus demo, not GPS navigation.

name: Jarvis Local
summary: An offline deterministic command desk for notes, tasks, date/time and safe arithmetic, with a CLI and loopback web interface. Not generative AI or voice control.

name: Recall Study Cards
summary: An offline-first browser flashcard desk with due dates, review grades, deck editing and validated JSON backup/import.

name: Study Sprint Planner
summary: Build a capacity-aware coursework timetable, flag work that cannot fit before deadlines, and export a printable plan plus calendar file. The browser edition saves tasks in this browser and does not send reminders.
